full_judgment: 2. The facts, in short, are that on 26-3-1988 at 7-30/8-00 PM informant Abu Taher, his elder brother deceased Fazle Karim, Noor Soleman (PW 2), Mosleuddin (PW 4), Ruhul Amin (PW 6) and others went upon the land belonging to the informant and others on Dag No. 770 of MRR khatian No. 1311 corresponding to Dag No. 240 of DP khatian No. 1077 in mouza Ramgati in order to plough and plant 'Aus' paddy. At that time accused Dayemuddin, Mostufa, Noor Nabi @ Shanu, Mahibullah and others forming unlawful assembly being armed with shol, cheni dao and lathi, etc went there and attacked the informant party by encircling them. Dayemuddin asked Fazle Karim, the elder brother of informant Abu Taher, to stay away from the land but Fazle Karim refused to do so. At this accused Dayemuddin gave shel blow on the right side of the chest of Fazle Karim, accused Shanu gave shel blow on his back and accused Mahibullah gave lathi blow on the head of the said victim, Fazle Karim and as a result he sustained bleeding injuries on his person and fell down on the ground. Then other accused Tafazzal, Gaznabi and Nasu also dealt lathi blow causing injuries on different parts of the body of the said victim, Fazle Karim. While witness Noor Soleman came forward to rescue the victim, the accused Gaznabi struck on his head with lathi and also the right hand. Accused Mozibul Haque and Ruhul Arnin broke his right hand. Accused Azad and Masod caused injury on the finger of his left hand by lathi blow. Accused Azizul Haque caused bleeding injuries on his left leg by shol blow. Alamgir, Nasir, Shahid also assaulted him with lathi. After hearing hue and cry, Jaynal Abedin, Muzammil Huq Chowkider, Abdul Matalib and others came and saw and heard about occurrence. Injured Fazle Karim was taken to Alekzandar Hospital but doctor found him dead. Other injured persons were given treatment.
